description: This file defines a React component 'UnifiedStatusIndicator' that visually represents the status of an agent, including icons, labels, descriptions, and optional detailed information. It also provides helper functions related to agent status evaluation and prioritization.

methods.name: UnifiedStatusIndicator
methods.description: A React functional component that displays an agent's status with appropriate icon, label, and optional detailed info.

methods.name: isStatusHealthy
methods.description: A helper function to determine if an agent's status is considered healthy based on its state and health score.

methods.name: getStatusPriority
methods.description: A helper function that assigns a sorting priority to different agent states for ordering purposes.
